why: ${x} resolves to {k: [a]}, so p is {k: [a]} {k += b}, which every implementation resolves to k = [a, b]; with the substitution in place all of them give [b]
review: is a substitution required to behave exactly like its value inside an object concatenation (ekrich/sconfig#611)? Under the spec's 'possible implementation' p is self-referential and k's lookup skips ${x}, giving [b]
